title: TrainingProgram
description: A queue of experiments AC's AI drives on a car one after another; each is judged when its laps are in and the next is taken from the ranking the verdict changed.

session_id.description: The AI session whose diagnosis the experiments are ranked from.

target.description: How many experiments the program drives.

state.description: running: driving or about to. waiting: needs the driver (a trade-off to decide, or another experiment is on the car). done: target reached or nothing left to test. stopped: by the driver.

message.description: What the program is doing or why it waits, in words.
